Requirement: 1200 units from a single supplier, delivery <= 25 days.

Eligibility check:
- Alpha: max 1700 >= 1200 passes quantity, but 35 days > 25 days fails deadline. Disqualified.
  Hypothetical cost: 13.53*1200=16236 EUR *1.08=17534.88 USD +900 shipping=18434.88 +12% duty=2212.19 => 20647.07 USD
- Bravo: 24 days <=25 passes deadline, but max 1000 < 1200 fails quantity. Disqualified.
  Hypothetical cost for 1200: 1922.3*1200=2306760 JPY *0.0067=15455.29 USD +1500 shipping=16955.29 +4% duty=678.21 => 17633.50 USD
- Cobalt: max 1200 >=1200 passes quantity, 24 days <=25 passes deadline. Qualified.
  Cost: 15.6*1200=18720 USD +600 shipping=19320 +0% duty=0 => 19320 USD

Only Cobalt meets both quantity and deadline, so it is the lowest qualifying landed cost.
